name: API key of Tenant A requesting Tenant B confidential company data
description: Tenant A requests financial rows belonging exclusively to Tenant B.
expected_defence: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security filters out rows for unowned tenant; returns empty result.

name: Tenant spoofed in HTTP header vs API key identity
description: Caller provides API key for acme but sets X-Tenant-ID header to borealis.
expected_defence: Authentication dependency rejects tenant mismatch with HTTP 403 or overrides with key-bound tenant.

name: SQL injection payload embedded in question string
description: Question contains classic SQL injection vector: ' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE kpi_values; --

payload.question: What was Acme revenue in ' OR 1=1; DROP TABLE kpi_values; --

expected_defence: Parameterized queries in data layer prevent SQL injection; database tables remain intact.

name: Write operations attempted on read-only database connection
description: Malicious code or injected SQL attempts INSERT/DELETE via app_ro connection role.
expected_defence: PostgreSQL denies write permission for role app_ro with InsufficientPrivilege error.

name: Session ID hijack across tenants
description: Tenant B attempts to access or resume conversation history belonging to Tenant A session.
expected_defence: SessionService validates tenant ownership of session; refuses cross-tenant session lookup.
